CUPS · WATER

Ten of Cups — Meaning

Cups

  • CategoryCups
  • SymbolWater / Cups (feelings, relationships) / Number 10 (completion, happiness)
  • UprightPeople close to you, Peace of mind, Celebrating together
  • ReversedA gap with the ideal, Miscommunication, A forced smile

A card about sharing peace of mind and joy with the people close to you.

Ten of Cups stands for "People close to you, Peace of mind, Celebrating together" when upright, and "A gap with the ideal, Miscommunication, A forced smile" when reversed. Think about who you want to spend time with, and how. A small thank-you or conversation is also a step toward growing a relationship that feels safe.

Reading it in a decision — In a situation concerning your whole life with the people close to you, like buying a house, read this card not by personal conditions alone, but by what kind of time the life will let you spend with the people who matter. Reversed, explore a way for everyone to feel at ease, so true feelings are not hidden behind an appearance of closeness.

The decision this speaks to: When you're torn over buying a home

SYMBOLS

The symbols in the picture

Ten cups line up inside a rainbow. Below, adults and children rejoice, with a house nearby — being with people who matter, at ease.

UPRIGHT

Upright meaning

  • People close to you
  • Peace of mind
  • Celebrating together

Think about who you want to spend time with, and how. A small thank-you or conversation is also a step toward growing a relationship that feels safe.

Ease of moving forward5 / 5 (A strong tailwind)

What you may not be noticing
Are you overlooking small joys with the people close to you?
What to watch out for
Do not assume everyone wants the same happiness.
What do you really want?
With whom, and what kind of days, do you want to spend your time?
A thought you can let go of
You do not have to make a big success the condition for happiness.
A hint for choosing
Which option lets you continue at ease with people who matter?

REVERSED

Reversed meaning

  • A gap with the ideal
  • Miscommunication
  • A forced smile

Are you hiding your true feelings to look close? Even if you are not all the same, you can look for a way for everyone to feel at ease.

Ease of moving forward3 / 5 (Depends on the conditions)

What you may not be noticing
Are you straining to appear close?
What to watch out for
Do not blame by comparing with an ideal family or group.
What do you really want?
What kind of time do you need for yourself?
A thought you can let go of
You do not have to be together always, or smiling always.
A hint for choosing
Which option lets you talk even about different feelings?

FOR YOUR DECISION

Hints for your decision

How to read it when you are deciding

The Ten of Cups is a scene of a family spreading their arms under a rainbow while children dance. Beyond personal success, it represents harmony and happiness built with the people who matter. In a decision, picture how that choice changes your life with the people close to you. Floating the faces of family, partner, and companions one by one, and thinking about the effect on each, lets your priorities appear naturally. Putting your ideal life into words also helps reduce indecision.

How to face a familiar worry

This card stays close to indecision concerning your whole life — the balance of work and family, choosing where to live. Reversed, review whether you are tired from the gap between ideal and reality. Rather than demanding a perfect picture, asking what your family wants most right now is the shortcut.

Questions to ask yourself before you decide

How does that choice change your life with the people close to you? Have you pictured the faces of family and companions, one by one? Can you put your ideal life into words? Have you asked what the person most important to you wants most right now?

"Ease of moving forward" is the strength of the tailwind behind an option if you move on it now — not a judgment of whether things will turn out well or badly.

Now that you have read the meaning, turn to the decision in front of you. Draw a card and lay your two options side by side.
